history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all. There are no bars, nothing loads, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help me fix this?

I can help you troubleshoot your service issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- Your phone number
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line status is currently active, so let’s proceed with troubleshooting your phone’s service.

To begin, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? This will help determine if Airplane Mode is on, if there’s a SIM card issue, or if there are any other visible problems. 

If you’re not sure how to check, let me know and I can guide you through the steps.
My status bar shows Airplane Mode is on, No Signal, Data Enabled, and the battery is at 87%.

It looks like Airplane Mode is currently enabled on your phone. When Airplane Mode is on, all wireless connections—including cellular service—are turned off, which is why you have no signal.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. After you do this, check if your service returns (you should see signal bars appear). Let me know if you need instructions on how to turn off Airplane Mode or if your service is still not working after turning it off.
Airplane mode is now OFF, but I still don't see any signal bars and I have no service.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, let’s check for possible SIM card or network issues next.

Could you please check your SIM card status on your phone? This will help us determine if your SIM card is detected and working properly. If you need instructions on how to check your SIM card status, let me know. Otherwise, please tell me what your phone reports for the SIM card status (e.g., active, missing, locked, etc.).
Actually, my phone reports that the SIM status is 'active.'

Thank you for confirming that your SIM status is active. Since Airplane Mode is off and your SIM is active, the next step is to check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from connecting to the network and affect both service and picture messaging.

Could you please check your APN settings and let me know if they are marked as “correct” or “incorrect”? If you need help checking this, let me know.
My APN settings are correct. The APN name is 'fast.telecom.net' and the MMSC URL is set correctly too. What should I try next?

Thank you for confirming your APN settings are correct. Since Airplane Mode is off, your SIM is active, and your APN settings are correct, let’s try a simple but effective step: rebooting your device. Restarting your phone can often resolve temporary network issues and help it reconnect to the cellular network.

Please restart your phone now. After it powers back on, check if you have service (signal bars) and let me know if the issue is resolved or if you still have no service.
I just rebooted my phone and it restarted successfully, but I still don't see any signal bars and I still have no service.

Your account and line are active, your bills are paid, your SIM is active, and your device is properly activated. Since you still have no service after rebooting and all settings appear correct, this may indicate a more complex network or hardware issue.

At this point, I’ve guided you through all standard troubleshooting steps. I will transfer you to a human agent who can investigate further or escalate the issue if needed.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
